name: Bottomix – Mobile Bottom Menu
author: ollysis

sections.description:
Bottomix – Mobile Bottom Menu creates a streamlined sticky bottom navigation menu for mobile visitors. The plugin allows website owners to provide an intuitive mobile navigation bar with customizable icons, labels, and layouts to improve usability on smartphones and tablets.

With Bottomix, you can customize your mobile menu to match your website design. Use the built-in settings panel to configure menu layouts, colors, typography, border radius, elevation shadows, and responsive visibility breakpoints.

How to Configure and Use

  1. After activation, go to Appearance > Menus in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Create or select a menu and assign it to the Bottomix Mobile Menu display location.
  3. Navigate to Bottomix Menu from the dashboard sidebar to access the settings panel.
  4. Customize your menu layout, colors, typography, and responsive display rules.
  5. Click Save Changes to publish your mobile bottom menu.

Key Features

  • Mobile Sticky Navigation: Display a persistent bottom navigation bar on mobile screen sizes.
  • WordPress Menu Integration: Assign any standard menu created under Appearance > Menus.
  • WooCommerce & Wishlist Support: Display shopping cart counts and wishlist indicators directly in the mobile bar.
  • Custom Styling Options: Configure background colors, gradients, borders, padding, and blur effects.
  • Typography Controls: Select Google Fonts, adjust font sizes, weights, and letter spacing.
  • Icon Management: Choose icons, customize positions (top, bottom, left, right), and adjust icon sizing.
  • Responsive Breakpoint Controls: Define the maximum screen width at which the mobile menu is displayed.
  • Ready-to-Use Presets: Quickly apply design presets to match your site aesthetics.

Features

  • Limitless Customization
  • Flexible Enable/Disable Option
  • Background Customization
  • Comprehensive Styling for Main Menu
  • Border Control & Curved Borders
  • Dynamic Shadow Effects
  • Adjustable Spacing & Padding
  • Grid-Based Menu Layout
  • Icon Customization & Management
  • Typography Options for Menu Items & Icons
  • Advanced Google Font Family Selection
  • Custom Icon Upload Support
  • Multiple Icon Positioning Options
  • Mobile Responsive Design
  • Cross-Browser Compatibility
  • WooCommerce Cart & YITH Wishlist Integration
  • Stunning Premade Designs
  • RTL support

Compatibility

  • Any WordPress Theme.
  • Page Builders like Elementor, Gutenberg, Beaver Builder & Other Page Builders.
  • Compatible with All types of SEO Plugins.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New screen from your WordPress website dashboard.
  2. Search for Bottomix – Mobile Bottom Menu (or upload the .zip archive).
  3. Install and activate the plugin, that’s it!
sections.faq:
How can I customize colors & size?

Use the Bottomix settings panel (Bottomix Menu) in your WordPress admin dashboard to configure the plugin styling.

How can I customize menu items?

Use the Menu Items screen (Appearance > Menus) to configure the navigation.

Does the plugin come for free?

Yes, it’s totally free.

Does the Plugin slow down your site?

No, the plugin is lightweight, fast, and does not affect your website loading speed.

Is Bottomix Mobile Menu responsive?

Yes, it’s fully responsive and optimized for all mobile viewports.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works seamlessly with every WordPress theme.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Security fix: Sanitized menu icon classes via sanitize_html_class and escaped all HTML attributes with esc_attr to prevent stored script injection.
  • Hardened AJAX handlers by removing unauthenticated nopriv hooks.

1.0.1

  • WordPress.org review compliance fixes: removed prohibited marketing claims, eliminated arbitrary custom_css, converted all inline dynamic scripts and styles to standard WordPress enqueue APIs (wp_add_inline_style and wp_add_inline_script), and removed redundant load_plugin_textdomain call.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Bottomix – Mobile Bottom Menu.
